The Harvest on the Shady Side

阴坡上的收成 · 641 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A village farm had supplied wheat and seasonal vegetables for years. A drought reduced its grain harvest and left its potato crop unusually small. Maru, an agricultural adviser, visited. Farmers wanted more fertilizer for the same ground. Maru noticed that young trees on a shady slope had survived without extra irrigation. Leaf litter held moisture. She asked the farmers to compare the two sides of the hill before deciding what to buy.

2The sunny side once supported productive agriculture. A mill bought its wheat, and cattle grazed there after the harvest. Farmers had used machinery to plow every row. Mechanization saved labor but left the soil bare. Dry wind carried dust to a timber fence. Maru checked a seedling and found delicate roots near a moist layer. Water was scarce. She wanted to compare root growth before they bought a fertilizer with a different mix of nutrients.

3They made two trial plots, each smaller than an acre. One kept the usual cultivation. The other used organic cover made from grass and hay. A strip of beans gave both shade and an edible crop. A grower wanted to sow a resistant soy variety meant for a large plantation. Maru chose a native bean that could flourish in a dry spring. The village had ample seed to repeat the trial without risking anybody's entire livelihood.

4A neighboring farm brought a bamboo pipe to irrigate the trial. One end leaked beside an apple tree and left a wet patch. A young farmer wanted to increase the supply. Maru asked her to measure the excess first. They fixed the pipe and delivered a small amount close to each plant instead of spraying the whole field. A bucket collected what remained. Less water ran downhill. A small test showed that the soil stayed cooler under the cover after midday.

5Maru noted that the farm had once grown cane near the water and walnut trees higher up. It had depended on abundant rain. The first trial used beans because a crop tolerant of scarcity gave quicker evidence. A pupil measured acidity and counted how often the plants began to bloom. The grower left a patch of weeds nearby to attract insects. A useful comparison had to include the plants that might compete for water.

6In summer a beetle damaged a few leaves. A grower wanted to spray both plots. Maru checked nearby ornamental shrubs and found the damage near one edge. They removed the affected leaves and watched. The plum and pear began to ripen on the shady slope. Wild berries and a small squash also reached maturity. A late frost could still hurt the crop. A grower noted which varieties would blossom in time. The trial showed why climate mattered without making each rainy day or hot afternoon the explanation for every change.

7At harvest the mill bought the wheat and families split a surplus of beans. A cook put young beans in a kettle with celery and made the broth simmer. She added salty mustard sparingly and let people rinse the fresh berries. An agriculture pupil weighed out seed by the gram. He listed fruitful plants he could tend after the dry period. The adviser warned against setting a fixed irrigation quota per hectare. They kept the trial plots so another class could compare what happened in a wetter season.

8A child asked which field received extra fertilizer. Under the grass on the shady side, the soil felt cool. A grower proposed planting an avocado and a grapefruit tree near a palm to try another crop. Maru asked him to check which ground was fertile and which fruit the village would consume. Cooks might choose a bitter leaf or oily fruit for different reasons. Good farming had to suit the plot as well as the market. The boy remembered their result from the cool soil.

四级汇总词汇 · 27中文译文

阴坡上的收成

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1村里的农场多年来供应小麦和时令蔬菜。一场干旱让粮食减产，土豆也格外小。农业顾问马鲁来看看。农民想在原地多施肥，她却发现阴坡上的小树不用加灌也活着。枯叶留住了水分。买东西之前，她请农民先比较山坡两侧。

2向阳处原先生产力不错。磨坊买走小麦，收割后牛群在那里吃草。农民用机器犁过每一行。机械化省力，却让土全露了出来。干风把尘土吹到木篱上。马鲁拔起一棵苗，看见细嫩的根靠着湿土。水本来就少，买另一种营养配方的肥料前，她想先比较根系生长。

3他们做了两块试验田，每块不到一英亩。一块按旧方法耕，另一块用草和干草作有机覆盖。一带豆子既能遮阴，也能吃。种植户想试大种植园用的抗性大豆品种。马鲁选了能在干燥春季长好的本地豆。村里的种子足够再做一次，谁也不用拿整年的生计去冒险。

4邻居送来竹管给试验田灌水。一头在苹果树边漏水，地上积了一摊。年轻农民想加大供水，马鲁请她先量多余的水。他们修好管，只给每株植物旁送少量水，免得喷遍全地。一只桶接住剩余的水，往山下流的少了。中午后测一测，覆盖物下的土更凉。

5马鲁提到，农场过去在水边种甘蔗，高处种核桃，依靠充足的雨。第一轮试验用豆，是因为耐缺水的作物能较快提供结果。学生测酸度，记开花的频次。种植户在附近留一片杂草引昆虫。比较要有用，也得把会争水的植物算进去。

6夏天有甲虫咬了几片叶。一名农户想两块地都喷药。马鲁查过附近的观赏灌木，发现问题只在一侧。他们摘掉受损叶片，接着观察。阴坡上的李子和梨开始熟，野莓和一只小南瓜也熟了。晚霜仍可能伤作物。农户记下哪些品种来得及开花。试验看出了气候的作用，也避免把每个雨天或炎热下午都当成解释。

7收割时，磨坊买走小麦，各家分剩余的豆。厨师把嫩豆和芹菜放进壶里小火煮汤，少加一点咸芥末，请大家把新鲜莓果洗一洗。农业班学生按克分种，列出旱期后还能照料的多产品种。顾问提醒，别给每公顷定一个死的灌水额度。试验田保留下来，另一个班碰到更湿润的季节也能对照。

8有孩子问哪块地多施了肥。阴坡草层下的土摸着很凉。种植户想在棕榈旁种牛油果和葡萄柚来试试。马鲁请他先看哪块地肥、村里人会吃什么。厨师可能因为不同目的挑一片苦叶或含油的果子。种东西要合土地，也要合市场。男孩一摸那把凉土，就能想起他们最先得到的结果。
